description.text: Deck Build Box Stellar Miracle, released on 19 July 2024 with the Stellar Miracle expansion: ten packs of it and 171 cards of 52 kinds for building decks, cards that had done well in official tournaments such as Buddy-Buddy Poffin and Iono, with 12 of each of the eight basic Energy in a new design. Some are Sword & Shield cards reprinted. A card box with four dividers and a VSTAR marker came with it. This set holds the 44 kinds besides basic Energy.
